importantInfo.title: IMPORTANT REMINDER // IMPORTANT REMINDER // IMPORTANT REMINDER
importantInfo.body:
As our volume continues to increase, we must remain focused on the little things and continue to execute.

Here are some reminders of things that continue to cause drag regardless of our growth; if we do not execute; growth will only continue to exacerbate the problems. 

1.   POC's need to be out withing 48 hours per our guarantee, this is our promise to our referral partners -just because we track by Thursday doesn't mean we are hitting the mark.
2.   MCM Notes all done by Monday morning
3.   Tasks need to be a priority, not a second thought, please ensure that everyone is checking and completing these in a timely fashion; this is part of the documentation and administrative part of everyone's responsibility.
4.   Authorizations/PSF's/MNRs are NOT AN OPTION; if you don't do the auth that's due, there's no point in doing the visit; you are doing it for free...if an auth is due and no more visits are eligible, reschedule the visit and complete the auth; or have a discussion with the patient and take self pay until auth has been obtained.
5.   Auth visit limits and Annual visit limits are a real constraint; if you have a patient that has a red dot on their appointment or the red thumb on the eligibility tracker; you must understand what the reasoning is...PCC's should be using tasks or communicating if they need provider assistance; if you see this but PCC's haven't communicated to you, please ask and include me, Dawn, Debbie, Jazmin, and Kim so we can identify where gaps are in the process.

Thank you for your help in buttoning these up!

importantInfo.title: LIVE: Google Review Game
importantInfo.body:
Our Google Review game is still going! It ends at the end of October ! 
AI is pulling info from these reviews to help recommend us, so if we can capture even more reviews, its a win-win all around. 
Some key things to have your patients mention in their reviews:
Which location,
who they saw (including if they were a PT, OT, DC)
what treatments they received 
what they came in for/how its improving

Each front desk should have a flyer posted with QR codes that take patients directly to the Google review option for your location. 
Each clinic should have small business cards with QR codes on them you can directly hand to the patients!

importantInfo.title: New MCM Protocols
importantInfo.body:
First, please please please make sure you are getting your MCM notes done before the following Monday. That is when MCM needs them done and we don't want to ruin this great relationship!

Second, MCM has told us that if they refer a patient to us and the patient doesn't have a specified frequency for care (visits per week), start the patient at 3 visit per week, document their highest pain score, and contact therapy@midwestclaimsmanagement.com with any questions

importantInfo.title: IMPORTANT: 2 appointments in one day
importantInfo.body: Moving forward, our patients are no longer able to use their insurance for 2 visits on the same day. It doesn't matter if the patient is seeing providers of different license types or getting treated for different body parts. Kim is having a hard time getting insurance to pay for either visit when this happens, so if a patient needs 2 appointments in one day, one visit must be self-pay.

importantInfo.title: POLICY CHANGE: Preserving Visit Counts during PTO
importantInfo.body:
Per Bridgette's email in your inbox:

We've heard your feedback around PTO and the impact that taking longer periods of time off can have on bonus eligibility. We listened to your concerns and have worked to come up with a solution that helps minimize that impact while still supporting you in taking the time off you need. 

Going forward, when you are out on PTO, visits will count towards your (and the provider who completes the visit) visit total if you successfully transition that patient onto another provider's schedule during your absence. This gives you the opportunity to maintain your and your clinic's visit numbers while also ensuring your patients continue receiving care while you are away.

Please check out the playbook in Bridgette's email for more details and eligibility on how to utilize this perk. 

As always, we as a leadership team appreciate everyone who provided feedback and are excited to share this solution and continue to make FIT better than before.

importantInfo.title: IMPORTANT: Watch your tasks on Prompt!
importantInfo.body: Please pay attention to your tasks on Prompt! Jazmin is now using this feature to track PSFs / Auths. To find your tasks, go to Prompt and click the green check mark in the upper right hand corner. Click the chain link icon to see which patient the tasks is referring to. Once you've completed the task, click the pencil icon, remove yourself from the assignment list, and then save the task.

importantInfo.title: Process Change: NP Access Blocks
importantInfo.body: When scheduling New Patients in a NP Access Block, instead of sliding the existing NP Access Block to another timeslot, please create a new NP Access Block so we can better track the Fill Rate of these Access Blocks. If a NP Access Block does not get filled within 24 hours, you will still slide the Block to open up that timeslot to existing patients.

To get there, go to your email inbox, click the 9 dots in the top left corner of your screen, and then click "SharePoint". Take some time soon to familiarize yourself with the "F.I.T.
